description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasWindowController component, specifically testing show/hide and show/close behaviors within a macOS environment using the XCTest framework. It uses Swift's async/await features and involves creating temporary directories, handling notifications, and interacting with UI components.

methods.name: panel controller shows and hides
methods.description: Asynchronous test method verifying that the CanvasWindowController's panel presentation shows and hides correctly, including placement and evaluation.

methods.name: window controller shows and closes
methods.description: Test method verifying that the CanvasWindowController correctly shows a window and responds appropriately to close and hide actions.
